card.name: Words after movement or location phrases
card.fires_on: Small words like the, a, in, one, here or the end of off-site that come right after a verb or preposition of movement or placement (down, off, on, from). The next word is usually a place or destination.

modes.label: Article after movement
modes.description: The or a right after a direction word such as down, on or of, before a noun like river or network.

modes.label: Place or transfer word
modes.description: A place or transfer word such as site, here, in or one completes a phrase about where something goes or is moved.
modes.example: that invisible vapor cloud moves off<<site>>.

card.plain: It fires on a small word in a phrase about something moving or being placed somewhere, just before the place is named.
